term: component collapse versus global identity and interpreted possibility
resolution: All modal operators remain relative to the supplied root and accessibility. S5 may have disconnected components. Component agreement yields component label identity only with full identity predicates or explicit restricted-domain extensionality; Universal extends that result to all supplied labels. A finite corpus inventory is not the whole fixed modal formula language. A predicate outside the collapse domain cannot be substituted into its no-contingency consequence. StrongBridge and real-world contingency remain open interpreted commitments, never historical Hume or Scott/Gödel axioms.
